extend_markdown_with_fenced_code: register the FencedCodeExtension to add fenced code block support to a Python-Markdown instance
parse_fenced_code_blocks: run the FencedBlockPreprocessor to find and extract fenced code blocks from markdown text lines
handle_code_block_attrs: use handle_attrs to parse id, classes, and config key-value pairs from a fenced code block attribute list
highlight_code_with_pygments: configure the FencedCodeExtension with CodeHilite to syntax-highlight fenced code blocks using Pygments
escape_html_in_code: use the _escape method to convert ampersands, angle brackets, and quotes to HTML entities in code content
